headline: Khaitan & Co, Trilegal act on Inox Clean Energy ₹10,000 crore proposed IPO
sum: Inox Clean Energy Limited has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering aggregating up to ₹10,000 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating of ₹8,000 crore and an offer for sale of ₹2,000 crore by the promoter…
detail: Inox Clean Energy Limited has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering aggregating up to ₹10,000 crore, comprising a fresh issue aggregating of ₹8,000 crore and an offer for sale of ₹2,000 crore by the promoter selling shareholder. Khaitan & Co is advising Inox Clean Energy and the promoter selling shareholder i.e., Devansh Jain on this IPO. The transaction team consists of Madhur Kohli (Partner), Vijayaraghavan (Partner), Sudhir Bassi (Executive Director), Anshul Mordia (Senior Associate), Hrithik Khurana (Senior Associate), Sarjana Das (Senior Associate), Associates Arjun Kapur, Sairandhri Nawale, Siddharth Jain, Nibha Yadav, Avantika Tanwar and Debarshi Ghosh…
